# Pull request

[English](pull_request_template.md) · [Português](pull_request_template.pt-BR.md) · [Español](pull_request_template.es.md)

Use EN, PT-BR or ES; paths, identifiers and commit messages stay English. Never include secrets or private information. State what actually ran and disclose omissions.

## Checklist

- [ ] Focused scope and current base
- [ ] Sources and safety warnings checked
- [ ] Applicable examples/tests checked or omissions disclosed
- [ ] Relative links and locale parity reviewed
- [ ] Original licensed content and attribution preserved
- [ ] No secrets, personal or proprietary data
- [ ] AI output understood and reviewed by a human when used
- [ ] Codex and CI checked for latest head when available
- [ ] Maintainer approval required before squash merge
